items.question: Which old spellings of a status are recognised when reading?
items.ticket: Existing values are normalised when read
items.chose: Maps only "in review" (after cleaning) to review; every other non-enum value, such as "in progress" or "done", reads as null.
items.instead: Also map other legacy spellings (for example "pending" or "in-progress"), or define the alias table differently.

items.question: How loosely is a stored value matched to a status when reading (case, whitespace, separators)?
items.ticket: Sandbox status is stored as free text (draft, Draft, in-review...)
items.chose: Lowercases, turns every run of whitespace, "-" and "_" into one space and trims the ends, so "-Merged-" reads as merged.
items.instead: Only trim and lowercase, or only treat whitespace as a separator, so "-Merged-" would not match.

items.question: What does reading return for a stored value that is not a status and not a known old spelling?
items.instead: Throw an error, or fall back to a default such as draft.

items.question: What does reading return for an empty or whitespace-only value?
items.chose: Returns null, because the cleaned empty string is neither a status nor an alias.
items.instead: Treat it as draft (the default), or throw.

items.question: Does reading match near-miss values such as typos, plurals or prefixes ("drafts", "pub")?
items.chose: No. It only accepts an exact match after cleaning, so near misses return null.
items.instead: Fuzzy or prefix matching to the nearest status.

items.question: Does writing normalise a value that is not exactly an enum value ("Draft", "in-review", " review")?
items.chose: No. Writing accepts only the exact lowercase enum strings and throws on anything else, including old spellings and differently cased or padded values.
items.instead: Run the value through the read normalisation first, then write the normalised status.

items.question: How does writing report an invalid status?
items.chose: Throws an Error with the message `Invalid sandbox status: "<value as given>"`.
items.instead: Return null or a result object, or throw a custom error type.

items.question: How does bulk reading handle a row whose status cannot be read?
items.chose: Keeps the row with status null and does not throw.
items.instead: Drop the unreadable rows, or throw on the first one.

items.question: How does bulk reading report unreadable values?
items.chose: Returns the raw stored strings (not cleaned), deduplicated by exact string and sorted, so "bogus" and "Bogus" both appear.
items.instead: Report row ids instead, report the cleaned values, or keep duplicates in input order.

items.question: Does bulk reading keep the input row order and any duplicate ids?
items.chose: Keeps the input order and one output row per input row, with no deduplication.
items.instead: Deduplicate by id or sort the rows.

items.question: Is the enum exposed as a runtime enum or constant, or only as a type?
items.ticket: Introduce a status enum with draft, review, published, claimed, merged
items.chose: Keeps the existing string-literal union type and adds a private Set of the values, with no exported runtime enum or list.
items.instead: Export a TypeScript `enum` or a const array so callers can enumerate the values.
